topic: End-of-service calculations that used to take a spreadsheet morning now run in seconds
format: Tight case study: company profile, problem, what changed, the one number that proves it worked
post:
An HR manager at a contracting firm in Muscat was spending 2.5 hours on every end-of-service calculation. Not because she was slow — because the data lived across three spreadsheets. Tenure records here, leave balances there, salary history somewhere else. One wrong cell and she'd start over.

She switched to SmartPRO Hub in Q1 this year.

The same calculation now takes under 40 seconds. Employee records, contract terms, Oman Labour Law logic — all of it runs automatically, in one place.

Her words: "I used to dread resignations. Now I process the final settlement before the meeting is over."

That's the actual problem here. End-of-service errors aren't just slow — they're a liability. Disputed settlements, Ministry of Labour complaints, ugly departures: most of them trace back to a wrong number in a spreadsheet nobody audited.

SmartPRO Hub runs the full calculation, flags anything that needs review, and closes the workflow in one pass. No cross-referencing. No guessing.

If you're still doing this manually, you're carrying risk you won't see until something goes wrong.

How many hours did your last exit take?
